name: frame-versioning

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan

description: How C2 extends without breaking: every frame keeps v 1; a later tag adds a t or an optional field, never a breaking change inside a frame. An unknown t is ignored, an unknown field on a known frame is ignored, and a known t with an unknown v is ignored exactly as an unknown t is (C2 decision 1, D1). The attach first-frame rule is the exception and wins: the first frame is attach, and its v must be 1 or the server closes 4000. Graded live by running the v0.2.1 client (from the contract-v0.2.1 tag) against tsbc serve.

instances.note: a known t with an unknown v is not a shape the sender emits; the receiver ignores it like an unknown t
an unknown field on a known frame breaks this sender's closed shape; a receiver ignores it (additive, R1)
the same frame without the later tag's optional field is valid
